title: ?author with no value filters on empty-string author
evidence: src/bookstore_handler.erl:28 maps the bare `?author` (parse_qs returns `true`) to `<<>>`, so the query filters books whose author is the empty string rather than returning all books
suggestion: Treat a valueless ?author the same as an absent filter (undefined) if that is the intended semantics

title: PUT requires full title+author (no partial update)
evidence: src/bookstore_handler.erl:44-47 runs the same validate/1 as POST, so PUT is a full replace and rejects a body missing title or author
suggestion: Acceptable for a replace-semantics PUT; document it, or add PATCH for partial updates
